item: A-012 part 3: nine main-thread-reachable loops outside src/database are converted, a src-wide ratchet fails on any new one, and the eight worker-only database rows are pinned to their callers
refs: PR pending; audit 0.5.0 A-012 part 3; follows PR #1489 #1495 #1501, R245, R247
summary: The classifier of tests/test_database_loop_heads_are_classified.py, run over the rest of src/ (117 scopes with a with/try-finally around a loop whose back-edge sits outside it on CPython 3.13), found nine reachable from a main thread, all converted: analytics/bulk_build.heal_bulk_build (an init_db step, run by main -> _serve before uvicorn takes the signals; a filtered comprehension in front of finally: session.close()), safety/crypto_erase._overwrite (the --panic CLI; the wait-loop form), and seven in the release-run restore subprocess (backup/merge.py x5, backup/stream_backup.read_stream_backup, monitoring/storage_events.end), where a terminal Ctrl-C reaches the child (src/monitoring/release_run.py starts it without start_new_session). Filtered comprehensions go through src.utils.interrupts.kept / kept_items (a frame of their own), the reindex id filter through its own helper, the rest to the guard-clause form; behaviour is unchanged, and the harm today was near nil, the processes exit on the interrupt. tests/test_loop_heads_reach.py computes each remaining scope's callers instead of a hand reason per scope: it fails on a main-thread entry (the console script, a __main__ block or module-level call, import time) unless the scope is converted, and lists on purpose only script, event-loop (R165) and dev-tool reach; 18 scopes are listed with a reason, two name collisions are dismissed with the exact entries they dismiss, and a mutation (reverting heal_bulk_build) fails it. tests/test_database_worker_only_pins.py imports Q's Graph and pins the eight worker-only rows of the src/database table that test_worker_only_callers_pinned.py does not (a local-only rule for common names such as run; the hand-read value entries are listed and their start lines are asserted). STATED LIMIT: the call graph is read by name; a call through getattr, a registry, a stored callable or a decorator is not seen, and a name that is a builtin, a common method or defined in three or more files is followed only inside its own file, so a real cross-file call through such a name is missed. A forward reachability with every ambiguous name expanded, read once by hand, added 16 rows, all name collisions. The table of chains, the 4 dismissed collisions and the 16 forward-reachability rows are in /mnt/project-files/osm-lane/a012-part3-main-thread-chains-2026-10-26.md. NOT done: the release-run subprocess is not given its own process group; scripts/ rows are listed, not converted.
